auto-save-logout.tooltip: Automatically save the current session when logging out or shutting down

auto-restore-login.tooltip: Automatically restore the saved session when logging in

restore-delay.tooltip: Delay before restoring session to allow desktop to fully load

excluded-apps.tooltip: Comma-separated list of applications to exclude from session saving (case-insensitive partial matching)

manual-save-keybinding.tooltip: Keyboard shortcut to manually save the current session

manual-restore-keybinding.tooltip: Keyboard shortcut to manually restore the saved session
